name: Mercury MA-4
about: Mercury MA-4 (1961 A ALP 1), a crewed vehicle (Mercury MA), launched 1961 Sep 13. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1961 Sep 13), held fixed
